title: ever IRYS|Sleeveless V-Neck High Low Wedding Guest Dress with Floral Applique
descriptionHtml:
Delicate floral appliques at the waist add a romantic and feminine touch to this chiffon wedding guest dress. The well-designed V-neck and sleeveless can better highlight your shoulder and neck lines, releasing more beauty and confidence.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: High-Low.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
